blocks.text:
This trip combines major cities, national parks, colonial architecture and several days at the beach.

Rio gets the trip off to a lively start with Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain and neighbourhoods along the ocean. At Iguazú, you see the same waterfall system from two different sides. Buenos Aires takes the trip from natural landscapes to architecture, history and gaucho culture. The pace then eases in Uruguay, first in historic Colonia del Sacramento and Montevideo, then with four nights in Punta del Este.

## How the trip changes from country to country

Rio opens with the busiest city itinerary, taking in Corcovado, the city centre and Sugarloaf Mountain in one day. Iguazú is a complete change of scenery. City streets and architecture give way to two days among the park's waterfalls and viewpoints.

Buenos Aires brings you back to a big city with a different culture. Explore its older neighbourhoods, the Teatro Colón, Plaza de Mayo and the history of tango. A trip to the Don Silvano ranch takes you beyond the capital to experience the Pampas and learn about gaucho traditions.

Your visit to Uruguay starts with a crossing of the Río de la Plata. Colonia del Sacramento is considerably smaller than the cities visited earlier, with cobbled streets and a lighthouse in its historic centre. In Montevideo, you'll take a sightseeing tour of the capital. The final four nights in Punta del Este are set aside for relaxation, with no packed schedule of compulsory activities.

The route leads from Rio's major landmarks to the natural scenery of Iguazú and the urban culture of Buenos Aires before ending at a slower pace on the Uruguayan coast.

The ferry from Buenos Aires to Colonia del Sacramento is a leg of the itinerary in its own right. The journey then continues across Uruguay by road.

Breakfast is included on nearly the entire itinerary, and lunch is included on selected days only. Domestic flights and admission to the Iguazú national parks are excluded from the tour price. Flights between countries and cities should therefore be budgeted separately from the $5005 tour price.
